user.title: Connect to Universal Listings Manager
user.description: Set a separate integration token in the ULM app first. Select the active Home Assistant administrator account used by your existing MCP connection.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Universal Listings Manager
reconfigure.description: Enter the current or rotated ULM integration token.

error.invalid_host: Use the internal Home Assistant app hostname ending in -olx-manager.
error.invalid_token: Use the separate token configured in the ULM app.
error.invalid_user: Select an active Home Assistant administrator.
error.invalid_auth: ULM refused access. Check the token and the app network.
error.incompatible: Update the ULM app and enable the integration token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ULM. Check its internal hostname and restart the app after changing the token.

abort.no_admin: No eligible Home Assistant administrator exists.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The integration connection has been updated.
